name: somos-servos-app
description: Aplicativo instalável do blog Somos Servos

scripts.android:init: npm run android:prepare-web && npx cap add android && python3 scripts/prepare-android.py
scripts.android:sync: npm run android:prepare-web && python3 scripts/prepare-android.py && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:prepare-web: mkdir -p www && cp index.html recursos.html pesquisa-bibliografica.html pesquisa-imagens.html pesquisa-historica.html referencias-salvas.html referencias-salvas.js percurso-servita.html aprofundamento-servita.html comunidades-servitas.html percurso-servita.pdf recursos-offline.js app.js styles.css service-worker.js sw-version.js icon-192.png icon-512.png icon.svg android-src/web/* www/ && cp manifest-android.webmanifest www/manifest.webmanifest && cp -R cartoes assets data www/
